correctness.rationale: All proper ideals lie in m; m²=0 makes the R-action on m factor through F_q, so proper ideals are exactly F_q-subspaces and L=1+Σ Gaussian coefficients. The only nonzero k-fold products have all factors R or exactly one nonzero proper ideal (L−2 choices) in one of k positions. Thus count 1+k(L−2). Field comparison factor D2=(L−2)(L−6), D3=(L−2)(L²+2L−20), D4=L⁴−64L+112 increasing/positive for real L≥3; recurrence D_(k+1)=L D_k+2^k(L−2)[k(L−2)−1] positive for all k≥4. For nonfields L=3 if r=1, L=q+4≥6 if r=2 and ≥17 for r≥3, so only L=6 at q=2,r=2 can collide. Both Z4[t]/(2t,t²) and F2[x,y]/(x,y)² have six ideals, 9 of 36 nonzero pairs, 27/36 zero products and different characteristics. Independent ideal-closure enumeration from ring operations checked both eight-element examples.
